newsitem.title: CHINA: China executes five for making fake spirits.
newsitem.headline: China executes five for making fake spirits.

text.p: China executed five people on Saturday for manufacturing and selling fake spirits which killed 36 customers and poisoned more than 100 others, the Xinhua news agency said.

Farmer-turned-businessman Li Rongping, his wife Jiang Hongmei and three others were put to death after the Supreme People's Court in the southwestern province of Yunnan rejected their appeals, Xinhua said.

The group was sentenced to death for diluting methanol and passing it off as spirits, resulting in the death of 36 customers and poisoning of more than 100 others between July 1995 and July 1996, it said.
Xinhua said the scandal had "shocked the entire nation" and sounded a warning to those seeking huge profits by making and selling fake goods.
